description: This file defines a Java class 'ClientConfigProperties' which encapsulates configuration properties for connecting to an AMQP 1.0 container, including connection timeouts, credentials, TLS settings, and reconnection strategies.

classes.name: ClientConfigProperties
classes.description: A class representing configurable properties for an AMQP client connection, with sensible defaults, getters, setters, and credentials loading logic.

methods.name: ClientConfigProperties
methods.description: Default constructor initializing properties with default values.

methods.name: ClientConfigProperties
methods.description: Copy constructor to create a new instance based on an existing one.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the hostname or IP address to connect to.

methods.name: setHost
methods.description: Sets the hostname or IP address to connect to.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number for the connection.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets the port number for the connection, validating the range.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username for authentication, loading from credentials file if necessary.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username for authentication.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password for authentication, loading from credentials file if necessary.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for authentication.

methods.name: getCredentialsPath
methods.description: Returns path to credentials file.

methods.name: setCredentialsPath
methods.description: Sets path to credentials file.

methods.name: loadCredentials
methods.description: Loads username and password from credentials file if not already set.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the container ID/name for the AMQP open frame.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the container ID/name for the AMQP open frame.

methods.name: getAmqpHostname
methods.description: Returns the hostname to be used in the AMQP Open frame.

methods.name: setAmqpHostname
methods.description: Sets the hostname to be used in the AMQP Open frame.

methods.name: getFlowLatency
methods.description: Returns the wait time for credits after link creation.

methods.name: setFlowLatency
methods.description: Sets the wait time for credits after link creation, must be non-negative.

methods.name: getLinkEstablishmentTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout for establishing a link.

methods.name: setLinkEstablishmentTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for establishing a link, must be non-negative.

methods.name: getInitialCredits
methods.description: Returns the default initial credits for links.

methods.name: setInitialCredits
methods.description: Sets the initial credits for links, must be non-negative.

methods.name: getSendMessageTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout for delivery updates after sending a message.

methods.name: setSendMessageTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for message delivery updates, must be non-negative.

methods.name: getRequestTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout for request responses.

methods.name: setRequestTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for request responses, must be non-negative.

methods.name: isHostnameVerificationRequired
methods.description: Indicates whether hostname verification is required for TLS connections.

methods.name: setHostnameVerificationRequired
methods.description: Enables or disables hostname verification for TLS.

methods.name: isTlsEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether TLS is enabled for the connection.

methods.name: setTlsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables TLS for the connection.

methods.name: getReconnectAttempts
methods.description: Returns the number of additional connection attempts (-1 for infinite).

methods.name: setReconnectAttempts
methods.description: Sets the number of additional connection attempts, -1 for infinite retries.

methods.name: getReconnectMinDelay
methods.description: Returns the minimum delay before reconnect attempts.

methods.name: setReconnectMinDelay
methods.description: Sets the minimum delay before reconnect attempts, must be non-negative.

methods.name: getReconnectMaxDelay
methods.description: Returns the maximum delay before reconnect attempts.

methods.name: setReconnectMaxDelay
methods.description: Sets the maximum delay before reconnect attempts, must be non-negative.

methods.name: getReconnectDelayIncrement
methods.description: Returns the delay increment used in backoff.

methods.name: setReconnectDelayIncrement
methods.description: Sets the delay increment for backoff, must be non-negative.

methods.name: getConnectTimeout
methods.description: Returns the total timeout for establishing the connection.

methods.name: setConnectTimeout
methods.description: Sets the total timeout for connection establishment, must be non-negative.

methods.name: getHeartbeatInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval for heartbeat frames, normally half of idle timeout.

methods.name: getIdleTimeout
methods.description: Returns the idle timeout after which connection is closed.

methods.name: setIdleTimeout
methods.description: Sets the idle timeout, must be non-negative.
